reggaeton.description: Shared Spanish urban/reggaeton lexical senses. Membership grants candidates, not automatic truth.

lifecycle.provisional_to_established: Recompute from distinct stable evidence; never promote from build count or duplicated playlists.
lifecycle.established_to_disputed: Mark disputed when a reviewed flag disproves a claimed meaning or source type; stop new auto-reuse while preserving provenance.
lifecycle.disputed_to_retired: Retire only after replacement or explicit review; keep aliases so existing cards and progress migrate deterministically.
lifecycle.membership_change: Removing an artist stops future contribution and consumption but does not erase historical evidence.

extension.consumer_probation: Add a new artist as consumer first; promote to contributor only after its evidence quality and register fit are audited.
extension.overlap_rule: A candidate may be offered when artist and sense share at least one register; support remains attributed to its original register.
extension.multi_register_rule: Evidence from different registers cannot be pooled to cross an admission threshold unless policy explicitly declares those registers equivalent.
extension.locale_rule: Country, era and subgenre metadata may rank candidates but cannot assign them without occurrence evidence.
extension.scale_rule: At larger membership, cap any one artist at one supporting-artist vote and deduplicate syndicated or repeated lyric lines by stable occurrence lineage.

rules: Only contributors seed the register; consumers receive established candidates but cannot amplify them.
A sense becomes established after two distinct occurrences or support from two contributors.
A provisional singleton is never added to a new context's menu, but may be reused for the identical cross-artist lyric line when exactly one sense matches.
Proper names, constructions, empty glosses and POS-less proposals never enter the register.
Candidate availability never assigns a sense: POS filtering or WSD must still choose it unless exact-line reuse applies.
Evidence counts deduplicate stable occurrence IDs and example IDs so repeated builds and duplicate playlists cannot manufacture support.
Registers are not transitive: an artist sharing another register does not bridge its senses into reggaeton.
A new member begins as a consumer; contributor status is an explicit reviewed promotion, never a consequence of playlist size.
An artist may belong to multiple registers, but evidence and thresholds are computed independently inside each register.
Source model, named prompt, run timestamp, sense ID and stable occurrence lineage remain attached to every contributing claim.
A flag can make a sense disputed and suspend exact-line auto-reuse without deleting the historical claim or learner identity.
Register membership may rank a candidate menu but never override a stronger occurrence-level POS conflict.
